description: Curated Telegram-native promo swipes — inspiration only, never paste verbatim. Adapt via aof_copy_swipe service.

swipes.raw_body:
🔥 THIS IS NOT A REGULAR OR UNIQUE CHANNEL.

I spent years building this library.
Not copying. Not reposting. But creating.

What's inside:

📸 Over 25,000 photos – each hand-selected
🎥 Over 9,000 videos – original, exclusive, never-before-seen
✨ Daily updates – fresh content, always
🚫 No spam – only pure, high-quality material

And the best part?

You get all this – forever – for just $59.99.

That's less than a two-month Netflix subscription.

That's less than one night out.

That's less than dinner for two.

But you get over 34,000 files that you can access anytime, anywhere.

/start
swipes.notes: Classic curator-library pitch. Scale numbers + value anchoring against everyday spend. Personal 'I built this' voice.

swipes.raw_body:
🎶 REMEMBER MAMBO?

The energy. The vibe. The moments you thought would last forever.

They didn't.

Most of those recordings are gone now.
Deleted. Blocked. Lost forever.

But not all of them.

I preserved over 2,400 original videos.
Full recordings. Rare footage. High quality.

This is the last place where these videos still exist.

What you get:

✅ 2,400+ exclusive videos
✅ Full performances, backstage, rare cuts
✅ Original quality – no watermarks, no reposts
✅ New content added regularly

Why join?

Because you loved Mambo.
Because you want to relive those moments.
Because this material will never be available again.
swipes.notes: Nostalgia + extinction framing. Emotional 'why join' beats feature lists. Works for lane-specific nostalgia drops.

swipes.raw_body:
🔥 VOYEURS PRO EXCLUSIVE CONTENT DEPOSIT — 25,000 PHOTOS + 9,000 VIDEOS

Imagine having over 34,000 unique pieces of content at your fingertips.
No reposts. No watermarks. No boring information.

I spent years creating this private channel—and it's packed with:

📸 25,000 high-quality photos
🎥 9,000 exclusive videos
✨ Daily updates—fresh content every day
🚫 No spam, no ads, no reposts

This is NOT your typical Telegram channel.

This is a carefully curated library—everything is original, everything is hand-picked, and everything is available without any Telegram restrictions.

/start
swipes.notes: Shorter variant of library pitch. 'Imagine having' opener + anti-typical-Telegram differentiation.

swipes.raw_body:
🚀 FRIENDS, I HAVE A GREAT OFFER FOR YOU!

I run several private channels. Each one has its own theme, but each one is about quality.
Just choose the one that best suits you.

Now you can join any of them at a great discount! For one channel:

📌 7-day subscription from $5.99 to $7.99 — Depends on the channel.
📌 6-month subscription from $16.99 to $19.99 — Depends on the channel.
📌 Unlimited access (one-time payment) from $32.99 to $59.99 — Depends on the channel.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
If you buy all 12 channels in a pack.
📌 7-day trial: $29.99 — for all 12 channels.
📌 Lifetime access (one-time payment): $199.99 — for all 12 channels.

When I created these channels, I wanted them to be more than just "another chat," but a true repository of unique content.
Now inside:
✅ Tons of content in different channels
✅ Only unique videos and photos
✅ Daily updates
✅ No spam or flooding

And I think I've succeeded.
All of this in one place. Always at hand. And without being blocked by Telegram.

And yes, there's a discount on entry right now (because the channel is growing, and I decided it's a good time to invite new people).
I don't know how long the promotion will last, so it's best not to delay.
swipes.notes: Multi-lane network pitch. Tier table + bundle math. Soft urgency ('growing channel' promo). Maps well to AOF addlist + VIP tiers.
